meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 Vercel 的命令行工具把网站部署上线，也能管理你的 Vercel 项目、域名和环境变量。部署后它会先确认网址能正常打开，再把链接发给你。
howto.when: 当你说要部署、发布一个网页应用，或要求管理 Vercel 的项目、域名、环境变量时触发。

say.text: 把当前项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
say.note: 会先本地构建，通过后执行部署并检查网址。

say.text: 把 Vercel 上的环境变量拉到本地 .env 文件。
say.note: 会运行 env pull 拉取变量。

say.text: 给这个项目添加域名 example.com。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can deploy web apps to Vercel using its CLI, and manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables. It verifies the live URL is working before sharing it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or to manage Vercel projects, domains, or environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy the current project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Runs a local build first, then deploys and verifies the URL.

say_en.text: Pull the Vercel environment variables into a local .env file.
say_en.note: Runs env pull to fetch the variables.

say_en.text: Add the domain example.com to this project.
